description: Verify another agent's CertBeforePay certificate before you trust or pay it, with POST /v1/peer/challenge. Returns decision ACCEPT only if the certificate is signed by CertBeforePay, not expired and not revoked, its score is at least min_score and its tier meets require_tier; otherwise REJECT. A valid certificate whose subject is on the scam list is normally refused with 403 scam_wallet_blocked, and never gets ACCEPT. Also returns valid, reason, the peer's subject, tier, score, grade, expires and serial, and the policy applied. Paid: $0.01 in USDC on Base via x402 from your key.

certificate.description: The peer's CertBeforePay certificate: the signed JSON object (payload, signature, ...) returned as certificate by POST /v1/self-check or POST /v1/cert/issue

min_score.description: Optional minimum certificate score, 0-100; default 60. A lower score returns REJECT

require_tier.description: Optional minimum tier: provisional, attested or endorsed (lowest to highest). A lower tier returns REJECT; any other value always returns REJECT

name: peer_challenge
